oral_examination.oral_examination: *38 Blind pockets can be seen, the mucous membrane covers the maxillary surface, and a small part of the tooth crown can be seen. There is no abnormal color, no redness, swelling, or congestion. Nothing special. CBCT shows 38 high vertical impaction.

source_handle: 38. Local povidone-iodine disinfection, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are incised and separated, and the crown of the tooth is cut and divided with a mobile phone to remove the obstruction, increase the gap, and loosen the pieces, so that the tooth can be erect. Routinely scratch and scrape the tooth extraction wound, suture and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
